description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver to your hand from your graveyard.
Imotekh the Stormlord's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Necron Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {3}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant to your hand from your graveyard.
Imotekh the Stormlord's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {3}.
Repeat.
